data.one_liner: An overlay loading progress indicator widget.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to display an overlay loading progress indicator on top of the screen. It can be easily started and stopped imperatively and customized using images, GIFs, or custom widgets.
use_when: You need to show a simple blocking loading indicator over your UI.
You want a quick way to display custom widgets or GIFs during async operations.
avoid_when: You need a more versatile solution with advanced features and improvements (use overlay_kit instead).
You require complex state management solutions for your app.
strengths: Very easy to use with start and stop methods.
Supports custom widgets, GIFs, and local images.
weaknesses: Author recommends using the newer overlay_kit package instead for advanced use cases.
